categories.main_business_segments: Hiroshima Gas operates primarily in three business segments: Gas Business (city gas manufacturing, supply, and sales), LPG Business (liquefied petroleum gas sales and related services), and Other (engineering, construction, and elderly care services). The Gas Business is the core segment, accounting for the majority of revenue, followed by the LPG Business and a small proportion from other activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include city gas manufacturing from imported LNG, LPG handling, and advanced gas distribution infrastructure. Production methods emphasize stable LNG procurement, efficient gas processing, and the use of smart energy systems. R&D focuses on gas utilization technologies, environmental technologies (such as energy-saving and emission reduction), and next-generation solutions like methanation and green LPG.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential households, commercial facilities, industrial users, and public institutions within Hiroshima Prefecture and surrounding areas. The company also supplies gas to other gas businesses and has a significant industrial client base, with major customers such as Micron Memory Japan. The end markets are primarily domestic, with a focus on energy consumers in the Chugoku region.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Hiroshima Prefecture, covering cities such as Hiroshima, Hatsukaichi, Higashihiroshima, Kure, Onomichi, Mihara, and Fukuyama. The company also has a presence in neighboring regions through its LPG subsidiaries and related companies, with all major assets and sales located in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hiroshima Gas operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain. It imports LNG (upstream), processes and distributes city gas and LPG (midstream), and delivers energy directly to end-users (downstream), including households, businesses, and industrial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the city gas and LPG business, expanding into renewable energy and green electricity, and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050. R&D is directed toward decarbonization technologies (e.g., methanation, green LPG), digital transformation (DX), and enhancing safety, resilience, and operational efficiency. The company is also committed to SDGs and ESG initiatives, with clear KPIs for CO2 reduction and diversity.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of city gas and LPG to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Additional income streams include gas equipment sales, engineering and construction services, and electricity retailing. The company uses a regulated and market-linked pricing model, with some hedging against raw material price fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other regional gas utilities and national players such as Osaka Gas, Tokyo Gas, and Seibu Gas Holdings. Hiroshima Gas is a leading regional energy provider in the Chugoku area, with a strong local presence and a focus on community trust and stable supply. The company differentiates itself through its integrated energy services and commitment to sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥91.6 billion, with a net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥1.69 billion. The company has over 1,600 employees and maintains a solid financial base with a 52.7% equity ratio. While sales have stabilized, profitability has declined in recent years due to market and cost pressures, but the company aims for medium-term growth through business expansion and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hiroshima Gas emphasizes safe, stable, and reliable energy supply as a lifeline for local communities. Its value proposition includes integrated energy solutions (city gas, LPG, electricity), customer-centric services, and a strong commitment to environmental sustainability and carbon neutrality. The company differentiates itself through regional focus, advanced safety and resilience measures, and proactive adoption of green and digital technologies.
